spec: In packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs, set process.exitCode = result.verdict === "flail" ? 2 : 0 at the end of the CLI instead of calling process.exit() immediately after printing so large piped --json output flushes completely without truncation (#625). Add a regression test in packages/flail-detector/test/cli.test.mjs.
title: flail-detector: use process.exitCode so large piped --json output is not truncated (#625)
